description: This file defines the interface ProductAttributeService for managing product attribute entities, including methods for saving, updating, and retrieving product attributes by various criteria within the shopizer e-commerce system.

classes.name: ProductAttributeService
classes.description: Interface defining services for handling product attributes, including CRUD operations and retrieval based on various identifiers.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new or updates an existing ProductAttribute, may throw a ServiceException.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductAttributes associated with the specified option ID within a MerchantStore, may throw a ServiceException.

methods.name: getByOptionValueId
methods.description: Retrieves ProductAttributes linked to the given option value ID within a MerchantStore, may throw a ServiceException.

methods.name: getByProductId
methods.description: Fetches ProductAttributes associated with a specific Product, MerchantStore, and Language, may throw a ServiceException.

methods.name: getByAttributeIds
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductAttributes corresponding to provided attribute IDs within a MerchantStore, may throw a ServiceException.
